title: Lyn Buchanan brought to an underground site with a reconstructed airliner-UFO collision

tellings.quote: they had reconstructed FAA style a collision between an airliner and a UFO

plain: A researcher and philosopher named Jason Jorjani, on Jesse Michels's podcast, passes on a story he says came from a man named Lyn Buchanan. According to Jorjani, Buchanan was taken to a facility deep underground in California, at a time the story does not give. There, he says, someone had rebuilt the wreckage of a collision between a passenger airliner and a UFO, laid out the way the FAA, the US agency that oversees civil flying and investigates crashes, rebuilds a crashed plane. If true, it would mean someone secretly investigated a crash between a plane and an unknown craft.
